name: Sumeragi Amane
source:
Amane is the head of the Ryourankai. She is in the same class as [url=/c804]Shou[/url] and is suspicious of him at first but grows to like him. She’s very serious and doesn’t let anything interfere with her work. She has a really impressive kick (which she uses on her big brother quite often).

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/24/flyable-heart-review/]Liemyx's review[/url]]
